symbol_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: primary symbol for OpenJobs, a Brazilian job opportunities and professional community web app; this symbol will also be its browser favicon. Create one original polished geometric logo symbol, no text. Brand direction: opportunity, an open doorway and upward career progress. A bold cobalt-blue open rounded-square / open O shape with a clean rising forward path formed by negative space, suggest an O and J subtly without writing literal letters. Make the silhouette distinctive, simple, friendly and confident, with thick balanced strokes and only two or three broad geometric parts so it reads clearly at 16x16 pixels. Flat vector-like design, precise edges, cobalt #1769D5 with optional navy #102944 small accent. Center a single symbol filling about 85% of a square canvas. Actual transparent background, no white rectangle, no shadows, no gradients, no textures, no mockups, no stationery, no captions, no grids, no multiple variants. This is a final reusable brand asset, not a presentation.
logo_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final horizontal OpenJobs logo on actual transparent background. Use the attached brand symbol as the identity reference: preserve its recognizable open rounded O / doorway with the rising curved path, its cobalt and navy colors and all major shapes. Compose ONE compact horizontal logo lockup: the symbol on the left, and the exact single word "OpenJobs" on the right in a clean bold modern geometric sans-serif. "Open" is dark navy #102944 and "Jobs" cobalt #1769D5. Text must read exactly OpenJobs, capitalization O and J; no space between words. Wordmark capital letters about 60 percent of symbol height, optically aligned, generous but balanced space between symbol and type. Broad, landscape canvas with aspect about 3:1 and narrow outer transparent padding. Precise smooth clean logo artwork, no mockup, no textures or decoration, no tagline, no extra icons, no variants, no labels. Keep the supplied symbol design consistent and typography perfectly legible. Transparent background, no white rectangle.
